title: CHITEST validates singleton blank/error arguments in order before checking shape and returns #N/A on shape mismatch or 1x1 ranges
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, CHITEST(actual_range, expected_range) shares CHISQ.TEST's admission and kernel: single-cell blank or error arguments are checked in argument order before comparing shapes (so CHITEST(blank, NA()) returns #VALUE! while CHITEST(NA(), blank) returns #N/A), shape mismatches and 1x1 inputs (df = 0) return #N/A, and valid tables return CHISQ.DIST.RT(sum((A - E)^2 / E), df). Matches 2,853/2,853 full-bank CHITEST rows.
basis: Measured across all 2,853 full-bank CHITEST rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence bank2-answers-chitest-{scalar,more,special}.json) and Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 43, Data!A1:A3 vs Data!E1:E3).
